title: एकाधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 201 · The austerities of Sunda and Upasunda

summary.en: Narada tells of the demon brothers Sunda and Upasunda, inseparable in all things, who by fierce austerities win from Brahma the boon that nothing but each other can kill them. They return home and feast and revel.
summary.kn: ಎಲ್ಲದರಲ್ಲೂ ಬೇರ್ಪಡದ ಸುಂದ ಉಪಸುಂದರೆಂಬ ದೈತ್ಯ ಸಹೋದರರು ಉಗ್ರ ತಪಸ್ಸಿನಿಂದ ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಹೊರತು ಯಾರಿಂದಲೂ ಸಾವಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂಬ ವರವನ್ನು ಬ್ರಹ್ಮನಿಂದ ಪಡೆದ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ನಾರದರು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅವರು ಮನೆಗೆ ಮರಳಿ ಔತಣ ವಿಲಾಸಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಳುಗುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: नारद सुन्द और उपसुन्द नामक दैत्य भाइयों की कथा सुनाते हैं, जो हर बात में अभिन्न थे और कठोर तप से ब्रह्मा से वर पाते हैं कि एक-दूसरे के सिवा कोई उन्हें न मार सके। वे घर लौटकर भोग-विलास में डूब जाते हैं।
summary.te: అన్నిటిలో విడదీయరాని సుంద ఉపసుందులనే దైత్య సోదరులు ఉగ్ర తపస్సుతో పరస్పరం తప్ప మరెవరి చేతా మరణం లేదనే వరాన్ని బ్రహ్మ నుండి పొందిన కథను నారదుడు చెబుతాడు. వారు ఇంటికి తిరిగి వచ్చి విందు విలాసాలలో మునిగిపోతారు.
summary.ta: எல்லாவற்றிலும் பிரியாத ஸுந்தன், உபஸுந்தன் என்ற அசுர சகோதரர்கள் கடுந்தவத்தால் ஒருவரைத் தவிர வேறு எவராலும் இறப்பில்லை என்ற வரத்தை ப்ரஹ்மாவிடம் பெற்ற கதையை நாரதர் சொல்கிறார். அவர்கள் வீடு திரும்பி விருந்திலும் களியாட்டத்திலும் மூழ்குகிறார்கள்.
summary.ml: സുന്ദൻ, ഉപസുന്ദൻ എന്നീ അസുര സഹോദരന്മാരെക്കുറിച്ച് നാരദൻ പറയുന്നു; എല്ലാത്തിലും അവർ പിരിയാത്തവരാണ്. കഠിന തപസ്സിലൂടെ, തങ്ങളെ പരസ്പരം അല്ലാതെ മറ്റാർക്കും കൊല്ലാനാവില്ല എന്ന വരം ബ്രഹ്മാവിൽ നിന്ന് അവർ നേടുന്നു. അവർ വീട്ടിലെത്തി വിരുന്നിലും ആഘോഷത്തിലും മുഴുകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 1.201; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Aug 22 2026

verses.text: नारद उवाच

meaning.en: Narada said:

verses.text:
शृणु मे विस्तरेणेममितिहासं पुरातनम् ।
भ्रातृभीः सहितः पार्थ यथावृत्तं युधिष्ठिर ॥

meaning.en: Listen to me, Yudhishthira, with your brothers, as I tell this ancient history at length, just as it happened.

verses.text:
महासुरस्यान्ववाये हिरण्यकशिपोः पुरा ।
निकुम्भो नाम दैत्येन्द्रस्तेजस्वी बलवानभूत् ॥

meaning.en: In the line of the great asura Hiranyakashipu there was once a lord of the Daityas named Nikumbha, radiant and mighty.

verses.text:
तस्य पुत्रौ महावीर्यौ जातौ भीमपराक्रमौ ।
सहान्योन्येन भुञ्जाते विनान्योन्यं न गच्छतः ॥

meaning.en: Two sons of great valor and fearsome might were born to him; they ate together and never went anywhere without each other.

verses.text:
अन्योन्यस्य प्रियकरावन्योन्यस्य प्रियंवदौ ।
एकशीलसमाचारौ द्विधैवैकं यथा कृतौ ॥

meaning.en: Each did what pleased the other and spoke pleasantly to the other; they had one nature and one conduct, as if a single being had been made into two.

verses.text:
तौ विवृद्धौ महावीर्यौ कार्येष्वप्येकनिश्चयौ ।
त्रैलोक्यविजयार्थाय समास्थायैकनिश्चयम् ॥

meaning.en: Grown up and very powerful, they were of one mind even in their undertakings, and they resolved together to conquer the three worlds.

verses.text:
कृत्वा दीक्षां गतौ विन्ध्यं तत्रोग्रं तेपतुस्तपः ।
तौ तु दीर्घेण कालेन तपोयुक्तौ बभूवतुः ॥

meaning.en: Having taken their vows, they went to the Vindhya mountain and practiced fierce austerity there. After a long time they became rich in ascetic power.

verses.text:
क्षुत्पिपासापरिश्रान्तौ जटावल्कलधारिणौ ।
मलोपचितसर्वाङ्गौ वायुभक्षौ बभूवतुः ॥

meaning.en: Worn by hunger and thirst, wearing matted hair and bark, with their limbs caked with dirt, they lived on air alone.

verses.text:
आत्ममांसानि जुह्वन्तौ पादाङ्गुष्ठाग्रधिष्ठितौ ।
ऊर्ध्वबाहू चानिमिषौ दीर्घकालं धृतव्रतौ ॥

meaning.en: They offered pieces of their own flesh in sacrifice and stood on the tips of their toes, arms raised and eyes unblinking, keeping their vow for a very long time.

verses.text:
तयोस्तपःप्रभावेण दीर्घकालं प्रतापितः ।
धूमं प्रमुमुचे विन्ध्यस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Heated for a long time by the power of their austerity, the Vindhya mountain let out smoke, which seemed a marvel.

verses.text:
ततो देवाभवन्भीता उग्रं दृष्ट्वा तयोस्तपः ।
तपोविघातार्थमथो देवा विघ्नानि चक्रिरे ॥

meaning.en: Then the gods, seeing their fierce austerity, became afraid, and to break their austerity the gods put obstacles in their way.

verses.text:
रत्नैः प्रलोभयामासुः स्त्रीभिश्चोभौ पुनः पुनः ।
न च तौ चक्रतुर्भङ्गं व्रतस्य सुमहाव्रतौ ॥

meaning.en: Again and again they tempted both with jewels and with women, yet those two of great vows never broke their vow.

verses.text:
अथ मायां पुनर्देवास्तयोश्चक्रुर्महात्मनोः ।
भगिन्यो मातरो भार्यास्तयोः परिजनस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Then the gods made an illusion before the two great-souled ones: their sisters, mothers, wives and household appeared,

verses.text:
परिपात्यमाना वित्रस्ताः शूलहस्तेन रक्षसा ।
स्रस्ताभरणकेशान्ता एकान्तभ्रष्टवाससः ॥

meaning.en: terrified, thrown down by a rakshasa with a spear in hand, their ornaments and hair loosened and clothes slipping from them.

verses.text:
अभिधाव्य ततः सर्वास्तौ त्राहीति विचुक्रुशुः ।
न च तौ चक्रतुर्भङ्गं व्रतस्य सुमहाव्रतौ ॥

meaning.en: All those women ran up to them and cried out, Save us! Yet the two of great vows did not break their vow.

verses.text:
यदा क्षोभं नोपयाति नार्तिमन्यतरस्तयोः ।
ततः स्त्रियस्ता भूतं च सर्वमन्तरधीयत ॥

meaning.en: When neither of them showed agitation or distress, then the women and all the apparitions vanished.

verses.text:
ततः पितामहः साक्षादभिगम्य महासुरौ ।
वरेण छन्दयामास सर्वलोकपितामहः ॥

meaning.en: Then the Grandfather himself, the grandsire of all worlds, came to the two great asuras and offered them a boon.

verses.text:
ततः सुन्दोपसुन्दौ तौ भ्रातरौ दृढविक्रमौ ।
दृष्ट्वा पितामहं देवं तस्थतुः प्राञ्जली तदा ॥

meaning.en: Then the brothers Sunda and Upasunda, firm in valor, saw the god Grandfather and stood with joined palms.

verses.text:
ऊचतुश्च प्रभुं देवं ततस्तौ सहितौ तदा ।
आवयोस्तपसानेन यदि प्रीतः पितामहः ॥

meaning.en: Together they said to the lord and god: If the Grandfather is pleased with this austerity of ours,

verses.text:
मायाविदावस्त्रविदौ बलिनौ कामरूपिणौ ।
उभावप्यमरौ स्यावः प्रसन्नो यदि नौ प्रभुः ॥

meaning.en: skilled in illusion and in weapons, mighty and able to change form, may we both be immortal, if the lord is gracious to us.

verses.text: पितामह उवाच

meaning.en: The Grandfather said:

verses.text:
ऋतेऽमरत्वमन्यद्वां सर्वमुक्तं भविष्यति ।
अन्यद्वृणीतां मृत्योश्च विधानममरैः समम् ॥

meaning.en: Everything else you ask will be granted except immortality. Ask for some other arrangement of death, equal to that of the immortals.

verses.text:
करिष्यावेदमिति यन्महदभ्युत्थितं तपः ।
युवयोर्हेतुनानेन नामरत्वं विधीयते ॥

meaning.en: This great austerity was undertaken with the thought that you would make yourselves immortal; for that reason immortality is not granted.

verses.text:
त्रैलोक्यविजयार्थाय भवद्भ्यामास्थितं तपः ।
हेतुनानेन दैत्येन्द्रौ न वां कामं करोम्यहम् ॥

meaning.en: You undertook this austerity to conquer the three worlds, lords of the Daityas, and for this reason I do not grant your wish.

verses.text: सुन्दोपसुन्दावूचतुः

meaning.en: Sunda and Upasunda said:

verses.text:
त्रिषु लोकेषु यद्भूतं किंचित्स्थावरजङ्गमम् ।
सर्वस्मान्नौ भयं न स्यादृतेऽन्योन्यं पितामह ॥

meaning.en: Grandfather, let us have no fear from any being in the three worlds, moving or unmoving, except from each other.

verses.text: पितामह उवाच

meaning.en: The Grandfather said:

verses.text:
यत्प्रार्थितं यथोक्तं च काममेतद्ददानि वाम् ।
मृत्योर्विधानमेतच्च यथावद्वां भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: What you have asked, exactly as you have said, I grant you. And your manner of death shall be just as you have chosen.

verses.text: नारद उवाच

meaning.en: Narada said:

verses.text:
ततः पितामहो दत्त्वा वरमेतत्तदा तयोः ।
निवर्त्य तपसस्तौ च ब्रह्मलोकं जगाम ह ॥

meaning.en: Having given them this boon, the Grandfather turned them back from their austerity and went to the world of Brahma.

verses.text:
लब्ध्वा वराणि सर्वाणि दैत्येन्द्रावपि तावुभौ ।
अवध्यौ सर्वलोकस्य स्वमेव भवनं गतौ ॥

meaning.en: Having received all their boons, the two lords of the Daityas, unslayable by all the world, went to their own home.

verses.text:
तौ तु लब्धवरौ दृष्ट्वा कृतकामौ महासुरौ ।
सर्वः सुहृज्जनस्ताभ्यां प्रमोदमुपजग्मिवान् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the two great asuras with boons obtained and wishes fulfilled, all their friends and kin rejoiced.

verses.text:
ततस्तौ तु जटा हित्वा मौलिनौ संबभूवतुः ।
महार्हाभरणोपेतौ विरजोम्बरधारिणौ ॥

meaning.en: Then the two cut off their matted locks and wore crowns, adorned with costly ornaments and wearing spotless garments.

verses.text:
अकालकौमुदीं चैव चक्रतुः सार्वकामिकीम् ।
दैत्येन्द्रौ परमप्रीतौ तयोश्चैव सुहृज्जनः ॥

meaning.en: In their great joy the two Daitya lords, and their friends, held an unseasonal moonlight festival fulfilling every desire.

verses.text:
भक्ष्यतां भुज्यतां नित्यं रम्यतां गीयतामिति ।
पीयतां दीयतां चेति वाच आसन्गृहे गृहे ॥

meaning.en: In every house the cries were: Eat, enjoy, make merry, sing, drink, give.

verses.text:
तत्र तत्र महापानैरुत्कृष्टतलनादितैः ।
हृष्टं प्रमुदितं सर्वं दैत्यानामभवत्पुरम् ॥

meaning.en: Everywhere, amid great drinking and the clapping of hands, the whole city of the Daityas was glad and joyful.

verses.text:
तैस्तैर्विहारैर्बहुभिर्दैत्यानां कामरूपिणाम् ।
समाः संक्रीडतां तेषामहरेकमिवाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: With their many pleasures, those shape-changing Daityas played, and years passed for them as if a single day.
